name: When should I call a professional for a slow drain?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a slow drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber if chemical drain cleaners don't work, if the clog reoccurs frequently, or if multiple drains in your home are slow simultaneously. These signs can indicate a more serious issue, such as a main sewer line blockage or damaged pipes, which requires specialized tools and expertise to diagnose and repair safely and effectively. Timely intervention can prevent more extensive damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if DIY methods fail, clogs reoccur, or multiple drains are affected. This indicates a potentially serious underlying plumbing issue.
